description: This header file defines the 'PlayerComponentsFactory' class and related classes for creating and managing media player components, including handling tunnel mode, audio/video decoders, and sink configurations within the Android shared platform of the Cobalt project.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkAndroid
classes.description: Custom audio sink implementation supporting tunnel mode with specific audio session IDs.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkCallbackStub
classes.description: Stub callback for audio sink to handle source status and error reporting.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsPassthrough
classes.description: Implementation of PlayerComponents that directly uses provided audio and video renderers.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating media player components, handling tunnel mode, decoders, and sink configurations.

methods.name: CreateComponents
methods.description: Creates media player components, including audio and video renderers, based on creation parameters.

methods.name: CreateSubComponents
methods.description: Creates and configures audio and video decoders, render algorithms, and sinks based on parameters.

methods.name: GetAudioRendererParams
methods.description: Calculates and returns parameters for audio renderer buffer sizes and cache.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a video decoder with specific parameters, including support for HDR and endianness.

methods.name: IsTunnelModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if tunnel mode is supported given creation parameters and sets secure pipeline requirements.

methods.name: GenerateAudioSessionId
methods.description: Generates a tunnel mode audio session ID via JNI calls.

methods.name: TryToCreateTunnelModeAudioRendererSink
methods.description: Attempts to create and verify a tunnel mode audio renderer sink with specific configurations.
